statement: Age-composition identity (id-age-composition) produces manifest flip rate ≥ 40% among real studies — cross-domain demographic confounding is flip-prone, not latent-only.
name: H-age-identity-flip-rate

statement: Catalog ExpectedDistortionType exact-match rate is below 50% — curator tags behave as mechanism priors, not taxonomy predictors.
name: H-catalog-exact-match

statement: Collider/selection studies produce latent-only flips under allocation sweep without manifest sign-flips at observed allocation.
name: H-causal-latent

statement: Confounder-labeled studies produce manifest sign-flips at observed allocation (IsSignFlip=TRUE) far more often than collider/selection studies — reversal mode differs by mechanism class.
name: H-causal-manifest

statement: Collider-proxy identity (id-collider-proxy) produces ≤15% manifest flip rate — near-zero manifest, predominantly latent Type-D geometry.
name: H-collider-identity-low-manifest

statement: At scale (≥10 collider/selection studies post expansion), zero manifest sign-flips: ColliderSelectionManifestCount = 0.
name: H-collider-no-manifest-theorem

statement: Collider and selection studies produce zero manifest sign-flips (DistortionType A or B) at observed allocation — including hernandez-diaz birth-weight collider tagged Expected A in catalog.
name: H-collider-no-manifest-v2
H-confounder-drift-type-d
statement: When studies are bucketed by real-world valid-time (cohort midpoint, not publication year), case-mix / geographic / situational confounder archetypes (MechanismClass in severity-case-mix, geography, sports-situation) show DriftDirection=rising toward clean Type-D outcomes in ConfounderDistortionTimeline, while age / institutional / SES archetypes (demographic-composition, organizational-unit, ses-income) show DriftDirection in (flat, single-decade) -- i.e. the drift is confounder-specific, not corpus-wide.

name: H-control-no-manifest-flip
statement: Zero manifest sign flips among control studies. These studies were selected for absence of paradox, so no pooled-vs-stratified reversal should be present.

name: H-control-safety-corridor
statement: No control study with MaxStratumImbalance < 0.033 (the safe-corridor threshold) has IsSignFlip=TRUE. The safety corridor hypothesis predicts zero flips below this boundary.

name: H-control-type-d-predominance
statement: At least 70% of control studies encode as Type-D (neutral allocation, no sign flip) — Type-D is the expected basin for studies selected for absence of paradox.
CorrectedGap is allocation-invariant for every study: MAX(SweepStudySummary.SweepCorrectedGapRange) < 0.0001 and zero failing studies.
name: H-corrected-gap-invariant

statement: C+ studies carry higher mean AllocationDistortion than C- studies and Type-D studies — magnitude inflation is the largest quantitative error class and invisible to is_sign_flip.
name: H-cplus-magnitude

statement: IsParadoxExplained ⟺ confounder manifest sign-flip: ExplainedConfounderCount = ConfounderSignFlipCount, no false-positive explained rows, no unexplained confounder sign-flips.
expected_outcome: ExplainedConfounderCount = ConfounderSignFlipCount AND FalsePositiveExplainedCount = 0 AND UnexplainedConfounderSignFlipCount = 0
name: H-explained-bidirectional

statement: IsParadoxExplained is TRUE for all and only confounder sign-flip studies — adjust-resolvable confounding is the unique condition that makes a reversal fully explained.
name: H-explained-confounder

statement: Geographic-composition identity (id-geographic-composition) has ≥25% Type-D fraction — stable latent-D presence distinct from manifest-flip-prone identities.
name: H-geographic-stable-type-d

statement: At least 95% of real-study StratumVariables carry a ConfounderIdentity map — ontology covers the corpus.
name: H-identity-map-coverage

statement: More than half of Type-D (SAFE) studies would flip their pooled winner under counterfactual allocation reweighting.
name: H-latent-d

statement: After ontology drain, id-mechanism-other contains ≤5 studies — the catch-all is no longer the dominant bucket.
name: H-mechanism-other-drain
H-perfect-balance-sufficient-safety
statement: Perfect allocation balance (ArmSizeRatio=0.5 AND MaxStratumImbalance=0.0) is a domain-agnostic sufficient condition for no manifest Simpson's Paradox — no such study produces IsSignFlip=TRUE regardless of mechanism class, domain, or confounder identity.
Every sign-flip study has SignalPurity strictly below 0.5.
name: H-purity
H-purity-inversion
statement: Mechanism classes with PolicyDefault='do-not-condition' or 'do-not-naively-adjust' (collider-selection, selection-frailty) have strictly higher mean SignalPurity than all stratify-* mechanism classes. High SignalPurity anti-predicts safe stratification — it is a trap for researchers who use data cleanliness as a quality heuristic.

name: H-purity-trap-flag-coverage
statement: PurityTrapFlag=TRUE covers ≥80% of collider/selection studies and ≤5% of demographic-composition confounder studies — the flag correctly discriminates the trap from the safe-stratification zone.

name: H-safety-corridor-lower-bound
statement: The minimum observed MaxStratumImbalance among all manifest sign-flip studies is 0.033 (flu-vaccine-elderly-mortality). No sign-flip occurs below this threshold — the gap [0.0, 0.033) is a corpus-level safety corridor.
Selection-frailty identity (id-selection-frailty) produces zero manifest sign-flips — pure latent-D geometry, no allocation-reversal at observed weights.
name: H-selection-frailty-zero-manifest

statement: Disease-severity identity within epidemiology domain shows zero manifest flips — latent-only geometry in that domain.
name: H-severity-epi-latent-only

statement: Disease-severity identity within medicine domain has manifest flip rate ≥45% — severity drives reversals in clinical settings.
name: H-severity-medicine-manifest

statement: Disease-severity identity shows lower Type-D latent fraction than age-composition identity — severity drives manifest reversals more than hidden sweep sensitivity.
name: H-severity-vs-age-latent

statement: Allocation-stable Type-D studies carry larger observed pooled gaps than latent Type-D studies.
name: H-small-effect
H-synthetic-edge-coverage
statement: All four corpus theorem boundary regions (near-zero-distortion, equal-weight sign-flip, zero-corrected-gap, collider-purity) are covered by at least one synthetic study.
expected_outcome: COUNTIF(Studies[IsSynthetic],TRUE) >= 4 AND all four boundary regions represented

statement: Four Category=theorem conclusions are witnessed: SignalPurity (conc-12/20) plus three new theorems from loops 73–75.
name: H-theorem-portfolio

statement: At least four Type-D studies are sweep-fragile: signal_purity=1, allocation_distortion=0, sweep_pooled_gap_range>0.3, allocation_fragility>=10 — perfectly safe by pooled metrics yet latent-flip under reweighting.
name: H-ultra-fragile

statement: All unexplained sign-flips (IsSignFlip=TRUE AND IsParadoxExplained=FALSE) have ConfounderIdentity ∈ {id-contested-org-choice, id-collider-proxy} OR CausalRole=contested — no unexplained flip belongs to an unambiguous confounder identity.
name: H-unexplained-flips-only-nonconfounders

statement: Studies with IsSignFlip=TRUE and CausalRole != confounder (contested or mediator) have IsParadoxExplained=FALSE.
name: H-unexplained-nonconfounder
